headline: Gold rebounds ₹148 today; silver flat at ₹1,75,000/kg
summary: Gold 24K rose ₹148 per gram today (about 1.18%) to ₹12,656, and 22K rose ₹135 to ₹11,600, while silver was unchanged at ₹1,75,000 per kg. Over the past week gold is down about 7.5% and silver about 7.9%, and over the full 29-day history both metals are lower, with silver down about 20% from its 26 October level. Today's rebound follows the low of 21 November, and international spot moves since today's rate are small, so the bounce looks modest rather than a clear trend change; a stronger rupee or softer US dollar could also be contributing.
outlook: With prices still well below last week's levels, buyers who need gold can consider spreading purchases over a few days rather than rushing, and should check making charges and GST separately from the quoted rate.
